condition_rule: Every claim inherits all common_conditions and adds its own conditions; do not extract a claim without both.

conditions: A subscribed MC service user cancels its subscription
claims.conclusion: Stop delivery to that subscriber; do not infer cancellation for all recipients.
Measurement time accompanies location information; accuracy is optional and at least one listed location element is supplied.
Track current affiliation and cancel the relevant group trigger when a user de-affiliates.
Notification is not proof of a newly performed measurement.
Do not include the UE label in location notification to the MC service server.
